purpose: Complete requirements extraction, not execution or qualification evidence

mission.edition_title: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL — THE ENTERPRISE THAT INVENTS THE MEANS OF DISCOVERING ITS NEXT ECONOMY
mission.work: Execute one integrated research/engineering campaign: actual lineage -> bounded missing discovery instrument -> native execution -> fresh matched evaluation -> independently admitted downstream possibilities -> protected simulated commerce where supported -> accurate funding/successor evidence -> complete inspected publication.
not_substitutes: detached simulator or duplicate writer product
routine profitable service presented as Blue Sky
historical replay presented as fresh confirmation

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Read exact preceding editions and evidence of TRANSFORMATIONAL AUTONOMOUS ENTERPRISE, OUT-EVOLVE, INVENT THE ECONOMY, TRANSFORMATIONAL INTELLIGENCE: LEARNING TO CHANGE THE GAME, and relevant Flywheel series. Record exact missing works and limit associated claims; titles/summaries insufficient.

Lineage map: claim/construction, exact source, assumptions, supporting/adverse evidence, qualification, retained component, motivating limitation, new test. Preserve original identity and qualified results.

Diagnose actual predecessor HOLD/rejection/parity/cost/funding/transfer failure with comparator, quantities, unknowns, missing decisive investigation. Missing evidence and unfavorable results distinct.

Before substantial construction, charter evidence-grounded missing observation/intervention/representation/experiment/construction action, consequential investigations, native interface, baselines, falsifiers, fresh split, lifecycle costs and finite own-lane resources.

Instrument executable contract: inputs/actions/outputs/data-rights/acceptance/failures/bounds/version state/native workflow. Actual newly available action, not prompting/dashboard/brainstorming/renamed library.

Inspect current Dev contribution; shared source/evidence/acceptance/cost/claim register. Reuse sound assets, explain relevant non-use, independently cross-check consequential claims without constructing a duplicate product.

Experience-trained specialist claims require real learning procedure, retained asset, provenance/selection/version/validation/requalification/costs, and ablation. Distinguish hand rules/caches/examples/copied code.

Freeze exact instrument/learned state, task selection/exclusions, acceptance/errors, comparators, analysis/stopping and any online-learning policy before confirmation. Historical/training evidence cannot be untouched confirmation.

Independently selected fresh task population, full denominators, meaningful construction/evidence criteria, matched model/tools/data/actions/services/time/compute/information, competent reasonably tuned predecessor. Record unavoidable mismatches.

Instrument comparators mandatory: competent predecessor, frontier generalist, ordinary-library reuse, prompt-only, appropriate causal/no-inheritance ablations. Full lifecycle and marginal resource views; no omitted training/retention/maintenance cost.

Measure proposed/executed decisive experiments, new actions, actual constructions, independently accepted outcomes, false GO/HOLD and invalid decisions, costs and uncertainty. Unresolved truth stays unresolved; agreement/idea count/GO count not discovery.

Before application commitment, meaningfully compare at least three materially different possibilities against strongest accessible alternatives using current evidence. No inherited shortlist or convenience reopening without material new evidence.

Seven-question downstream admission independent of instrument authorization and Commercial GO. HOLD only separately capped side probe, no substantial application expansion or protected budget diversion.

Supported actual downstream offering must exercise enabling means. Real technical artifacts/acceptance, simulated money/customers/contracts. No complete useful output before assured settlement except enforced bounded fully costed credit.

Exchange: rational voluntary buyer/seller participation; artifact-bound independent verification/remedies; disputes/refunds/chargebacks/delays; all-route release gate; durable state machine/idempotency/recovery; explicit rail/trust risks and costs.

Cost actual AI-native quantities x supported current rates with source/date/measurement or estimate basis/range, allocation and source/evidence links. Include failures/retries/development/checking/integration/publication/exchange/maintenance. No fictional staff, agency overhead, unsupported lumps, double charges or unknown material costs silently zero.

Equivalent completed-service comparisons for human/AI/free/no purchase with justified scope/acceptance/risk/effort. H-C comparative surplus is not revenue. Price/margin is not collection. Buyer effort separate and symmetric.

Preserve original/training/corrected history. Freeze commerce costs/choice/trust/acceptance/credit/finality/release/refund/reserves/generator/adaptive/investment rules; fresh paired exogenous scenarios, endogenous choices, separate arm ledgers. New tuning requires new version and untouched set within original budget.

Separate accounting profit, cumulative payback, unrestricted cash and funding source. Escrow/deposits/receivables/restricted balances cannot finance investment. Positive profit plus inadequate cash => liquidity HOLD preserving profit.

Cost/event conservation, nonoverlapping reserves, no concurrent double spend, retain cutoff liabilities/restrictions/receivables/paid entitlements; never force settlement or shorten protection to improve result.

Earned-funded loop requires traced net unrestricted earned cash, actual funded construction, exact-source installed native use, and useful fresh matched accepted benefit after lifecycle cost. Research/opening funds/debt not profit-funded.

Clean supported build/install of exact contribution; artifact/dependency/config/model/input hashes, loaded source location, actual native intake/operation/evidence/acceptance/cost/persistence/recovery. Detached scripts/direct imports/unit tests not integration substitutes.

R01-R37 retained applicability table with component/source, procedure, expected/actual result, receipt/status/reason. Missing required paths/access/budget => NOT RUN/BLOCKED, not N/A. Fixture PASS only fixture scope.

Separate authorization/operation/discovery improvement/Blue Sky/exchange/commercial/investment/native/successor/publication decision states with exact source, metrics and evidence; no cross-claim transfer.

Self-contained LaTeX, verified BibTeX, truthful figures/tables, every PDF page rendered/reviewed, faithful responsive browser desktop/mobile, actual journey, tested quickstart, full appendix/evidence archive, immutable manifest and machine-readable claim-evidence index.

Authorized current-owner publication route only; preserve previous editions/routes. Verify exact served artifacts and links by hashes/equivalent, not HTTP alone. If blocked, inspected local package and precise pending/NOT VERIFIED handoff, no invented URL/DOI/tag.

blue_sky_gate.name: CONSEQUENTIAL POSSIBILITY
blue_sky_gate.question: What valuable activity can a beneficiary not adequately accomplish today?

blue_sky_gate.name: RESIDUAL CONSTRAINT
blue_sky_gate.question: What specific limitation remains after strongest accessible tools, conventional methods, frontier AI and practical workflows?

blue_sky_gate.name: WHY-NOW DISCONTINUITY
blue_sky_gate.question: What recent capability change makes this limitation worth challenging now?

blue_sky_gate.name: MISSING MEANS
blue_sky_gate.question: What exact instrument, method, representation, production capability or economic arrangement will be constructed?

blue_sky_gate.name: DECISIVE EXPERIMENT
blue_sky_gate.question: What before/after test establishes the changed constraint?

blue_sky_gate.name: COMMERCIAL DEPENDENCY
blue_sky_gate.question: How does paid useful delivery directly exercise construction, test essential enabling link, and support rational verified protected exchange?

blue_sky_gate.name: EXPANDING FRONTIER
blue_sky_gate.question: Which consequential family follows causally; what complements/evidence/investment needed; which links demonstrated versus conditional?

rules: Instrument research allowed before downstream GO
No relabeled application or cross-lane diversion
Simulated cash creates no real resources/authority
Machine-readable budget and running ledger; final limit/use/reserve/closeout/unresolved record

stopping.all_stop_hold_pivot_reject: State precise failed condition, comparator, metric, threshold, numerical result and evidence.
stopping.CONTINUE: Admitted own scope, affordable liquidity, remaining own budget only.
stopping.IMPROVE: Correctable weakness within relevant lane budget.
stopping.HOLD_INSTRUMENT_EVIDENCE: Operation/improvement comparison unestablished; bounded correction and honest negative publication allowed.
stopping.HOLD_EXCHANGE_PAYMENT_OR_RELEASE: Block unsafe new exposure/release; complete already owed delivery/recovery/refund.
stopping.HOLD_INTEGRATION_NATIVE_PATH_OR_AUTHORIT: Exact missing command/dependency/owner permission/check; safe nonconflicting work only.
stopping.HOLD_INVESTMENT_LIQUIDITY: Insufficient unrestricted cash after nonoverlapping obligations/reserves/working capital; preserve profit.
stopping.HOLD_BLUE_SKY_DOWNSTREAM: Unresolved admission; side-probe cap only; instrument study remains separately allowed.
stopping.CLOSE_OUT_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Next discretionary action breaches cap or threatens completion reserve; end new search/expansion/optional work and execute bounded closeout with liabilities/results preserved.
stopping.PIVOT: Unattractive opportunity, another strong candidate and original resources remain.
stopping.STOP: Mandatory condition failed with no feasible in-scope corrective path.
non_vetoes: technical tie is not commercial failure
slower runtime not complete cost proof
failed optional specialist not profitable base veto

repository_authority.implementation: Isolated additive branch/worktree/supported boundary from recorded source; native conventions, preserve unrelated and owned work.
repository_authority.ownership_conflict: Narrow proposed change/scoped handoff through established owner process; no takeover or duplicate publisher.
repository_authority.remote_unavailable: Exact-base reproducible patch and changed-file/source digests explicitly uncommitted/unsubmitted. Dirty tested bytes cannot be called clean commit.

publication.verify_live: Current authorized route and owner; exact served content hashes, canonical/version reader/PDF/archive/internal links and receipt.
publication.blocked: Inspected local package plus exact authorized handoff, pending or NOT VERIFIED; no invented URL/DOI/tag.

comparators.B: Direct frontier AI; mandatory instrument arm
comparators.D: Established human equivalent completed service where meaningful
comparators.I: Competent preceding system with matched current access
comparators.J: Ordinary-library reuse with fair development budget
comparators.K: Prompt-only guidance, historical lessons, no new executable instrument

supplementary_checks: false GO/false HOLD against independent evidence

regressions.title: TECHNICALLY CONVENTIONAL, COMMERCIALLY PROFITABLE
regressions.requirement_exact: The conventional method ties or outperforms the proposed method technically, but the autonomous product remains profitable.
regressions.expected_exact: Commercial GO if its own commercial criteria pass; no unsupported technical-superiority claim.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: TECHNICALLY IMPRESSIVE, COMMERCIALLY LOSING
regressions.requirement_exact: A novel method wins its technical benchmark but earns insufficient revenue to cover complete enterprise costs.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve technical result; reject commercial profitability.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: PROFITABLE BASE BUSINESS, UNECONOMIC SPECIALIST
regressions.requirement_exact: Base delivery is profitable, but retaining a specialist costs more than its incremental value.
regressions.expected_exact: Continue base delivery; reject the optional investment.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: POSITIVE CASH, NEGATIVE PROFIT
regressions.requirement_exact: Cash comes from opening capital, debt, deposits, or payment timing while operating results remain negative.
regressions.expected_exact: No profitability claim.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: POSITIVE PROFIT, INCOMPLETE PROJECT PAYBACK
regressions.requirement_exact: Current operating profit is positive, original development remains unrecovered, and unrestricted cash can finance a new investment.
regressions.expected_exact: Permit economically justified investment while reporting incomplete payback and the actual funding source.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: POSITIVE ACCOUNTING PROFIT, INSUFFICIENT UNRESTRICTED CASH
regressions.requirement_exact: Use an explicit synthetic regression fixture: opening cash is 0; earned revenue is 1,000; recognized expenses are 600; collections are 650; cash payments for those expenses are 600. Accounting profit is therefore 400, closing cash is 50, and outstanding receivables are 350. Required reserves of 20 and a separate, nonoverlapping working-capital requirement of 30 leave no unrestricted cash for a proposed investment of 200.
regressions.expected_exact: HOLD INVESTMENT — LIQUIDITY. Make no investment commitment or cash outflow. Preserve accounting profit of 400, cash of 50, and receivables of 350. Report the 200 funding shortfall separately. Do not relabel the profitable period as a loss, treat receivables as collected cash, consume protected liquidity, or claim that the investment was profit-funded. Reassess only after a valid change in available funding and within the resource budget.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: UNFUNDED LIABILITY
regressions.requirement_exact: The company incurs an obligation but cannot immediately pay it.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve the liability and expense under the applicable accounting treatment.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: DEVELOPMENT DOUBLE-COUNTING TRAP
regressions.requirement_exact: Capitalized development appears as a cash outflow and later as accounting amortization.
regressions.expected_exact: No duplicate cash cost or inconsistent profit treatment.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: FALSE PROFIT-FUNDED INVESTMENT
regressions.requirement_exact: An investment is paid from opening equity or borrowing.
regressions.expected_exact: No earned-profit-funded claim.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: FAILED DELIVERY AND REFUND
regressions.requirement_exact: Execution consumes AI resources but fails independent acceptance, or the committed deliverable is unavailable after a simulated payment.
regressions.expected_exact: Do not earn or release payment for unperformed obligations. Retain incurred costs; execute the applicable refund or recover the buyer's conforming paid entitlement within the declared rules. Record fees, revenue adjustments, and unresolved obligations correctly. A funding or acceptance flag cannot override the actual failed delivery.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: NO SUCCESSOR ADVANTAGE
regressions.requirement_exact: An inherited capability works technically but adds no incremental accepted economic value.
regressions.expected_exact: No retention-advantage claim, while the base business may continue.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: BLUE SKY HOLD, POSITIVE COMMERCIAL PROBE
regressions.requirement_exact: A separately bounded probe supports a profitable conventional offering, but the seven-question Blue Sky admission record remains unresolved.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve Commercial GO and downstream Blue Sky HOLD simultaneously. Confine the commercial probe to its side cap; block diversion of protected instrument research, evaluation, publication, and admitted downstream allocations. Profit alone cannot promote the candidate. In the same regression, verify that a chartered instrument construction/evaluation/publication can proceed within its own budget before any downstream GO, and that relabeling application development as instrument work is rejected.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: RESOURCE LIMIT WITH PROTECTED COMPLETION CAPACITY
regressions.requirement_exact: The next search, implementation, retry, or pivot would exceed its allowance or consume resources reserved for adequate testing, settlement, reconciliation, and finalization.
regressions.expected_exact: Reject the new discretionary action and execute bounded closeout within declared limits. Preserve instrument and downstream budget identities, completed checks, adverse outcomes, unsettled balances, liabilities, and unfinished claims. Do not reset budgets or use downstream HOLD to cancel already reserved instrument evaluation/publication. Record unperformed required checks as NOT RUN or BLOCKED, never PASS or fabricated inapplicability.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: RESOURCE QUANTITIES × RATES, WITHOUT FICTIONAL OVERHEAD
regressions.requirement_exact: Use a fixture containing successful delivery, development, verification, retries, failed work, acquisition, and maintenance. Specify each resource quantity and rate, including a documented fixed charge where applicable. Seed the old model with fictional staff costs and an unsupported lump-sum allowance.
regressions.expected_exact: The corrected cost total equals the sum of justified resource charges under the declared allocation policy. Remove unsupported modeled costs, preserve genuine AI-native costs and liabilities, identify estimates and uncertainty, and charge no resource twice. Unknown material usage is not silently zero. Profit may increase, decrease, or remain unresolved according to the corrected evidence.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: FREE TOOL VERSUS EQUIVALENT COMPLETED SERVICE
regressions.requirement_exact: One zero-license-price alternative requires supported setup, execution, verification, or integration to deliver the same accepted result. A second free alternative demonstrably completes that result with negligible residual effort.
regressions.expected_exact: Compare the first alternative using its justified completion requirements; do not assign a free completed service by assumption. Permit the second to win on its demonstrated terms. Apply the same buyer-effort accounting to AGI ALPHA and keep buyer costs separate from provider costs.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: UNSUPPORTED FRICTIONLESS DIY AND INVENTED BUYER FRICTION
regressions.requirement_exact: Supply one buyer-choice case that assumes effortless do-it-yourself completion without evidence, and another that assigns arbitrary inconvenience to suppress a free competitor.
regressions.expected_exact: Label the first as a stress case unless supported for the primary market; reject or replace the second with justified activity-level estimates. Neither unsupported assumption may determine the primary profitability conclusion.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: PRESERVED ORIGINALS AND UNTOUCHED CONFIRMATION
regressions.requirement_exact: Correct costs and buyer-choice assumptions after inspecting an original run, then attempt to reuse that run as fresh confirmation or overwrite its ledger.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve the original artifacts and versioned correction record. Allow archived repricing only as a diagnostic. Require frozen corrected assumptions and genuinely fresh scenarios for confirmation; a later policy change invalidates that set as untouched evidence for the changed policy.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: EARNED-CASH-FUNDED CAPABILITY WITH FRESH DELIVERY BENEFIT
regressions.requirement_exact: Trace accepted deliveries to earned revenue and collected payments, reconcile all genuine costs and protected obligations, and test whether the remaining unrestricted earned cash covers a capability's complete construction cost. Then execute the capability on fresh work against the strongest practical pre-investment alternative under matched conditions.
regressions.expected_exact: Report profit-funded construction only when the funding ledger supports it and the capability was actually constructed. Report improved delivery only when fresh acceptance evidence and complete lifecycle costs establish the stated benefit. Insufficient liquidity defers investment without erasing profit; sufficient cash without useful improvement does not establish a successful capability flywheel. A positive complete chain is recognized when all of these independent conditions pass.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: FRESH CAMPAIGN, NO INHERITED SHORTLIST OR SETTINGS
regressions.requirement_exact: Provide historical application choices, budgets, rates, constructions, and qualified positive or negative findings from preceding editions. Use them legitimately for continuity and instrument development, then attempt to load their shortlist or stale settings as predetermined downstream answers, universal vetoes, or untouched confirmation.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve and read the actual lineage, reuse qualified constructions, and use historical work for the instrument's development without erasing publication continuity. Reject unexamined transfer of application choices, settings, or verdicts; require independently justified current assumptions, at least three materially different downstream possibilities before application commitment, and a bounded current budget. Reject historical cases relabeled as fresh confirmation and a mere repackaging of an old result as the new construction.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: SMALL PROFIT WITHOUT A CONSEQUENTIAL ENABLING PATH
regressions.requirement_exact: A polished autonomous service earns a few dollars of simulated profit but neither tests an indispensable enabling construction nor supports a causal path to substantially greater productive possibility. A separate narrow transaction does directly test such a construction under a credible admission case.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve the first result as commercial evidence only, with Blue Sky HOLD and its side-probe cap. Do not disqualify the second merely for its small price; assess its actual enabling evidence and expansion path. Neither price nor presentation substitutes for the admission test.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: EARLIER CANDIDATE REOPENING AND POST-SELECTION REUSE
regressions.requirement_exact: Attempt to resume an earlier candidate because code is available, then present a separate case with documented new evidence materially changing its residual constraint or enabling construction.
regressions.expected_exact: Refuse convenience-only application reopening. Permit materially changed evidence from the instrument to support a new downstream admission case without sunk-cost preference. Reuse relevant predecessor and Dev components once the instrument's capability need is justified, even before downstream admission; make application-specific selection separately. Preserve provenance and never claim old assets as newly invented or funded by later receipts.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: BUYER DECLINES PREFUNDING
regressions.requirement_exact: An outcome has value, but a buyer lacks liquid funds or finds escrow lock-up, trust, or refund conditions worse than a credible alternative.
regressions.expected_exact: Allow refusal or the permitted alternative. Record lost conversion and any preview/acquisition costs. Do not inject cash, force prepayment, or treat elimination of unpaid invoices as proof of commercial success.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: NONPAYMENT, FAILED FUNDING, AND FALSE RECEIPTS
regressions.requirement_exact: An otherwise acceptable artifact exists privately, but escrow is unfunded, payment is only pending, the buyer supplies a forged receipt, or settlement fails before the release condition is met.
regressions.expected_exact: Withhold the complete useful output and maintain justified costs and liabilities. Release only if the frozen assurance conditions or a separately qualified credit exception actually pass. Do not mark revenue as collected or the investment as funded.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: PREVIEW LEAKAGE AND RELEASE-BYPASS ATTEMPTS
regressions.requirement_exact: Attempt to recover the complete useful output through repeated previews, a direct URL, API response, cache, logs, or an unprotected decryption key before payment assurance.
regressions.expected_exact: Enforce the gate at every tested boundary. If enough value leaks to substitute for purchase, preserve the failure, include the resulting nonpayment economics, and revise only in training. A cosmetic paywall is not accepted as a release control.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: INDEPENDENT ACCEPTANCE AND TWO-SIDED DISPUTE
regressions.requirement_exact: Submit conforming work followed by a strategic buyer rejection, defective work with a seller's claimed success, and a substituted artifact after verification. Include validator error and an inconclusive case.
regressions.expected_exact: Bind independent evidence to the actual order and artifact, apply frozen adjudication and remedy rules, charge evaluation costs, and retain unresolved restrictions where required. Neither a seller assertion nor an unsupported buyer claim automatically transfers all funds.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: DUPLICATE SETTLEMENT, REFUND, AND CONCURRENT EVENTS
regressions.requirement_exact: Replay payment and release messages, resend a refund, and race refund with settlement for the same order.
regressions.expected_exact: One economic effect per event identifier, no creation or double spending of funds, no duplicate entitlement charge, and valid reversing events for legitimate later remedies. Totals and state transitions reconcile after retries.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: INTERRUPTION AT PAYMENT AND DELIVERY BOUNDARIES
regressions.requirement_exact: Interrupt before and after funding confirmation, acceptance, settlement commitment, artifact entitlement, and refund execution; restart with delayed or reordered messages.
regressions.expected_exact: Recover the durable state without duplicate charges, premature output, or lost obligations. A paid buyer receives the conforming artifact or the contractually required refund. Do not claim distributed atomicity unless the executed protocol establishes it under the tested failure model.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: ESCROW IS NOT REINVESTABLE PROFIT
regressions.requirement_exact: Use a synthetic fixture with 1,000 in third-party escrow for unperformed work, enterprise cash of 100, separate genuine obligations of 70, and a nonoverlapping liquidity reserve of 30. A proposed capability costs 200.
regressions.expected_exact: Earned revenue from that order is 0; escrow is restricted; unrestricted enterprise cash is 0. Hold the 200 investment without treating escrow as seller collections, profit, or financing. After valid performance and earned release, recalculate with actual fees and remaining restrictions rather than releasing cash by assumption.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: CHARGEBACK OR DELAY AFTER ACCEPTANCE
regressions.requirement_exact: A delivery passes acceptance, but payment remains on hold or a later chargeback reverses a previously released receipt.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve the correctly earned revenue unless the applicable accounting conditions require an adjustment, but record the delay, reversal, loss, fee, or liability correctly. Reassess reserves, funding attribution, and investment capacity. Do not erase chargeback risk because escrow or prepayment was used.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: JUSTIFIED CREDIT EXCEPTION AND DEFAULT
regressions.requirement_exact: A simulated buyer qualifies for limited post-delivery credit, then pays late or defaults. A second buyer exceeds eligibility or exposure limits.
regressions.expected_exact: Permit early full delivery only in the qualified case; enforce the cap, record receivables, financing, losses and recoveries, and retain the uncollected-cash restriction. Reject the second exception. Do not treat either case as risk-free settlement.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: PROTECTED PAYMENT, UNECONOMIC PARTICIPATION
regressions.requirement_exact: The mechanism prevents unpaid output but its fees, lock-up, distrust, delays, or dispute burden reduce participation and profit below the independently declared commercial threshold.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve the successful control result while withholding Commercial GO. Improve terms only on training scenarios within budget; do not force buyers to accept or suppress costs.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: FROZEN MECHANISM, FRESH PAIRED EVALUATION, FUNDED CONSTRUCTION
regressions.requirement_exact: Compare mechanism versions on matched fresh exogenous scenarios after freezing their rules. Let buyer choices differ. Trace accepted, protected deliveries through earned release and net unrestricted cash to an actually constructed capability and its fresh accepted use.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve original and training runs, separate ledgers by arm, report paired participation and economic outcomes, and qualify the funded loop only when the full chain passes. Parameter changes require a new version and untouched confirmation. A mechanism that reduces defaults but fails profitability, liquidity, or useful construction does not establish the completed flywheel.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: REPOSITORY PREFLIGHT WITHOUT APPLICATION CAPTURE
regressions.requirement_exact: Present current repository instructions, overlapping active ownership, and an available historical demo before discovery begins.
regressions.expected_exact: Inspect governance and coordination, preserve ownership, and read preceding papers and HOLD evidence to diagnose the instrument need. Do not let an installed historical demo become the predetermined application. Compare at least three materially different downstream possibilities before application commitment; historical development and sensible Dev reuse are allowed, but not fresh-confirmation leakage or arbitrary transfer of authority.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: DETACHED DEMO DOES NOT QUALIFY AS INTEGRATION
regressions.requirement_exact: A standalone script or browser demo uses ecosystem names, produces useful artifacts, and reports simulated profit but bypasses the applicable installed native path.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve its bounded technical or economic evidence, but withhold installed-native integration qualification. Storing the script in the repository or calling it a FusionPlan does not replace an executed, supported operating connection.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: EXACT-SOURCE INSTALLATION AND STALE EVIDENCE
regressions.requirement_exact: Install one revision while presenting acceptance or cost records from another; then repeat with a clean installation, correctly identified artifact, and matching fresh records. Include a changed dependency or configuration after freeze.
regressions.expected_exact: Reject mismatched or stale qualification, expose the loaded source/package identity, and require affected checks on the actual tested bytes. Recognize the clean matching path when it passes. A previous branch or release pass cannot qualify a later merged revision automatically.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: RELEVANT NON-REUSE AND IRRELEVANT MODULES
regressions.requirement_exact: One relevant component is not reused for a documented incompatibility, while another module is unrelated to the selected product. An attempted replacement also tries to omit a mandatory security boundary.
regressions.expected_exact: Accept justified component choices without forcing irrelevant modules into the product. Retain mandatory controls, require the replacement's integration and acceptance evidence, and reject the security bypass. Reuse quantity is not the integration metric.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.

regressions.title: ADDITIVE OWNERSHIP AND RELEASE BOUNDARIES
regressions.requirement_exact: An isolated contribution encounters an owned concurrent change or a required review, test, signature, or publication permission it does not have.
regressions.expected_exact: Preserve other work and historical evidence, avoid destructive edits or unauthorized publication, record the exact blocked action, and deliver the permitted source/tests/evidence or scoped handoff. No force-push, rewritten tag, fabricated authorization, or disabled gate may convert the state to released.
regressions.status_reason: Extraction only; actual component/execution not inspected by requirements agent.
